summary: Concord may ship skills that operate structures defined by accepted law and verified by Concord checks, starting with Domain-shape stewardship. Skills reuse the versioned release and central installation route, name only Concord operations and Product-declared tooling, and hold no independent evidence, approval, or law authority. Host-specific lane procedure stays host-owned; CD-0246 amends D1 to admit portable method skills. Domain-shape stewardship is shipped with admission, portability, install/upgrade and release-inventory checks.
title: Concord ships the skill that operates its Domain shape
